title: Ex Microsoft Employee tells secrets on why Windows 10 bugs exist 👨‍💻 - @Barnacules
summary: A former Microsoft SDET with 15 years on Windows gives his view on why Windows 10 updates keep shipping with bugs. He points to changes in how the company tests its software.
why: HN cites it as a first-hand account of Microsoft's QA cuts and reliance on automated tests in threads about buggy Windows updates.

quote.text: Hear about it first hand from an ex windows software tester
